# SignNow .NET SDK

> Official .NET SDK for SignNow's electronic signature API, targeting .NET Framework 4.6.2+, .NET Standard 2.0/2.1, and modern .NET versions. Provides a service-oriented architecture for integrating legally-binding e-signatures into applications, CRMs, and cloud storage solutions.

This SDK enables developers to embed SignNow's electronic signature functionality directly into their .NET applications. It supports document upload, signing workflows, user management, template creation, and comprehensive API interactions through strongly-typed models and async programming patterns.
